# Configured editorial signals

## Section openings

Café 🙂. In this **section**, we will describe setup. <!-- want "filler.section-announcement" -->

### Deployment

In this section, we will describe deployment.

## Transitions

With that being said, the server starts. It goes without saying that the client waits. <!-- want "filler.empty-transition" -->

## Praise

This is a game-changing solution for the team. <!-- want "hype.vague-praise" -->

## Metaphors

The service offers a rich tapestry of possibilities. Start a journey of innovation with the client. <!-- want "hype.metaphor-cluster" -->

## Guarantees

The service guarantees complete safety. <!-- want "hype.absolute-claim" -->

## Intensifiers

The very powerful client offers an incredibly innovative interface and an extremely useful command for every person using the service. <!-- want "filler.weak-intensifiers" -->

## Hedges

The result may possibly perhaps change. <!-- want "filler.stacked-hedging" -->

## Paired contrasts

It is not about speed. It is about impact. It is not about tools. It is about outcomes. <!-- want "syntax.paired-contrast-density" -->

## Triads

A powerful, seamless, innovative platform starts. A robust, transformative, unparalleled experience follows. <!-- want "syntax.triad-density" "hype.vague-praise" -->

## Alternatives

Whether you are a beginner or an expert, the tool helps. Whether you're a writer or a reader, the tool fits. <!-- want "syntax.whether-preface-density" -->

## Questions

The result? A better experience. The benefit? A brighter future. <!-- want "syntax.rhetorical-question-density" -->

## Ordered contrasts

It not only reads but also writes. It not just checks but also validates. <!-- want "syntax.not-only-density" -->

## Technical prose

The request requires authentication, authorization, and a checksum. The request may fail, and the server might retry.
The renderer draws a landscape. The travel API returns a journey duration. This is not a game-changing solution.
Under these conditions, the service guarantees complete safety. Does the server cache errors? No.

It not `only` reads but also writes. It not `only` checks but also validates.

The service not only validates requests but also checks permissions.
